title: Installation Jobs Price Book: New Interior Casing Charge
content:
**Price book — new interior casing charge on Installation Jobs**

The interior casing charge on an **Installation Jobs** record is the casing price: the method's interior trim charge per opening, shown in the product's price book by installation method, multiplied by the casing openings. The casing openings are the openings on the contract the job installs. The charge is dated the crew day the casing is fitted.

## How the charge is assembled

1. Amounts stated per casing opening are charged on every casing opening and together form the casing price.
2. A discount rate on casing is one combined rate — the sum of every rate that makes it up — and reduces the casing price once, never one rate after another.
3. The charge is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Elements of the charge

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Rate | the method's interior trim charge per opening |
| Casing openings | the openings on the contract the job installs |
| Date | the crew day the casing is fitted |
| Rounding | to the nearest cent, once, at the end |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A job installs a contract of 5 openings under a method with a hypothetical interior trim figure of 70.00 per opening, and the casing is fitted on 12 August. The charge is 70.00 multiplied by 5, that is 350.00, dated 12 August.
